ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is at the lowest of the food chain in this diagram?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is titled “Food Chains in Tundra.” It shows several horizontal food chains with arrows moving left to right. In the top chain, the sequence starts with the sun, then a picture of grass, followed by animals and finally mushrooms/decomposers. Reasoning: The lowest level of a food chain refers to the producer/base living organism, not the sun. In the top chain, the first living organism after the sun is grass, so the lowest part of the food chain is grass.
